title: Chapter 393: Monster Clan
content:
Chapter 393: Monster Clan

"From today onwards, I am the lord of Hecheng, and you are my people, and you are protected by me."

Zhong Yu's majestic words reached everyone's ears with the resounding voice and with the help of true energy.

All of a sudden, those people at the bottom began to discuss, igniting the crowd who had been silent because of the majestic atmosphere.

Did you hear me right?

The young man in front of him, who seemed quite dignified, actually said that he wanted to be the lord of this small city and protect them.

This is really good news.

Surprisingly, no one objected.

The small city in front of me is on the verge of extinction, and may be captured by monsters at any time, and the residents in the city will also become their prey.

The sword of Damos hanging over their heads constantly reminded them that their lives were not safe and they might die at any time.

Under such circumstances, what does it matter if someone comes to rescue them and protect them, even if the price is to become a part of that person's rule?

As for whether this is treason, whether it violates the laws of the Ming Dynasty, or whether it is considered rebellion, these ordinary people have all ignored it.

At this point, they can see that the shitty Ming Dynasty, the emperor who is so high and inviolable, and the extremely powerful imperial army are all fake.

At critical moments, no one can be relied upon.

Now even some mere monsters bullied their heads, lost a large area of territory, and had to swallow their anger to give in. How can these abandoned Ming survivors not be angry.

You know, they were not long ago, but the emperor who made them allegiance gave up and sold them to those demons.

This kind of betrayal was implanted in the bone marrow and penetrated into the soul. It is not too much to say that it is a life and death enmity.

Naturally, the people in the whole city really didn't have the slightest liking for the so-called Great Ming Dynasty, but were full of hatred instead.

So not long after the words finally fell, there was a lot of noise, then silence, followed by a wave that pierced the sky and the earth, and finally turned into a torrent.

"I'm waiting to bow!"

Just like that, with just one sentence, the whole city and the whole city surrendered from the bottom of their hearts to this strange force that had just popped up and didn't even know its footsteps.

Now the desires of the people in the whole city are very clear, and their needs are unexpectedly unified, that is...

Live, don't become food for demons.

It's such a simple appeal, a choice made by biological instinct.

As long as anyone can complete their choice, they can let go of everything and surrender to that person wholeheartedly.

...

Gather all the people in the city to go through the scene with them, declare their right to rule, and tell them that the city has changed its owner today, which is nothing more than a trivial matter.

It's just a small city, even if the world has a profound background, it can't change the fact that this city is small.

Under such conditions, the strength of the entire city is very small, and it can't form any resistance in the face of Zhong Yu's army.

Especially at a time when people in the city are unstable and have no beliefs, a powerful force suddenly appears to settle in. This is in line with the general trend and harmony, and no one will resist at all.

After dealing with such trivial matters, Zhong Yu has more urgent matters waiting for him to deal with.

Although some troubles in the city have been resolved, the whole small city is completely under control. Under Zhong Yu's huge accumulation of hundreds of worlds, he has already had sufficient talent reserves.

These people may not be very powerful, but it is still possible to rule a small county, restore its order, and calm the fear of the residents in the city.

Not to mention that there are huge and countless troops stationed nearby, which are enough to deter all Xiao Xiao.

The small county is not the point, it is just to find a foothold.

The real point is that the scale next to the county seat is slowly recovering, and its strength is still strong, which cannot be underestimated.

After all, there are still 30,000 monsters left, and with the spread of this victory, the monsters in several countries around the Ming Dynasty have heard about it, and more and more monsters began to come, planning to participate in such a battle. A once-in-a-century event.

You know, although the human nature of this world is slowly being suppressed by the demon way, the entire monster race slowly begins to recover, and its strength becomes stronger and stronger.

But it is undeniable that the combined power of the entire human race is definitely far greater than that of the monster race, otherwise it is impossible for humans to occupy 70% of the entire world.

Almost all the land suitable for cultivation has been robbed, and those monsters can only hide in the mountains and drink their blood, living an unbearably miserable life.

After all, it is the accumulation of the human race for tens of thousands of years. After a long time, the accumulated power is so powerful that it cannot be countered by the slow recovery of the monsters in the past thousand years.

It is precisely because of this that the monster's invasion of the human world is silent and small, and there is no major action at all.

Those who made big moves have long been wiped out by those human masters, how can they jump up to now.

In terms of top-level combat power, the human race is far superior to the monster race, so naturally those demon kings cannot be allowed to come out to make trouble.

Take the Huangshan Demon King this time as an example. If it weren't for the war in northern Xinjiang of the Ming Dynasty, there was a Dajin invasion of a scale and level that would not fall behind him at all.

Otherwise, the Huangshan Demon King would have been wiped out by the master team enshrined in the Ming Dynasty, how could it have the current glory.

Separation of a land, arrogance as king.

Nowadays, this kind of large-scale invasion of the monster race is not common in the entire continent, and it can even be said to be extremely rare.

According to the historical records in the mainland, the most recent time Lu Qing was 300 years ago, a demon king in the northern border of the mainland advanced and achieved the power of the seventh level.

Then with this strength, six sixth-rank demon kings were entangled in the demon clan where the strong are respected, collectively known as the Seven Saints of the Northern Territory, and there were hundreds of thousands of demon soldiers under their command.

When this force first appeared, it not only caused a shock among the monster races, but also caused quite a commotion among the human races all over the world.

When you are in high spirits, you will naturally do some shocking things to set off.

Therefore, the overly proud Seven Saints of the Northern Territory led more than 200,000 demon soldiers to the south.

Unfortunately, the empire to the south of them is the most powerful Qin Empire in the north of the entire human race.

With farming and warfare as the foundation of the country, and rewards of meritorious service as the ranks of advancement, the army of the Qin Empire is naturally extremely powerful, and it is proud of all empires in the world.

In that battle, the most elite central army of the Qin court was not mobilized. Only 30,000 local frontier troops were dispatched from the border counties and counties. This is how to attack.

However, in just one month, more than 200,000 demon soldiers were beaten and defeated, and then they chased them all the way for thousands of miles, deep into the demon land of the Northern Territory.

If it weren't for the fact that all the land of the Monster Clan in the Northern Territory was so barren that the seeds would not even be able to grow food, the 30,000-mile Northern Territory might have been captured by the Great Qin Empire.

However, because of this battle, all the seven saints of the Northern Territory were killed, and all the more than 200,000 demon soldiers under his command were also beheaded. The power of the demon clan in the entire Northern Territory was greatly damaged, and it has not recovered until now. The weather is difficult.

Also because of this battle, all the monsters in the world dare not easily peek at the various territories of the human race.

The mere Qin Empire is so strong, so as a powerful country in the world, even if its strength is not as good as it is.

But if the legal system is not destroyed, the ancestral temple and the country are still passed down to this day, no matter how bad it is, it is still very easy to destroy these monsters.

So in the past 300 years, I have never heard of a demon king who dared to invade the territory of the human race on such a large scale with such recklessness.

Now the Huangshan Demon King has done it, and the most difficult pass, there is a Dajin Dynasty to block it, it can be said that the wind is smooth, basically there is no obstacle, everything is taken for granted.

It can be seen from this that Huangshan Demon King can have the current climate, which to a large extent also represents a decline of human nature.
